answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in a cryptographic attestation chain verified by zero-knowledge proofs. Verification requires staking collateral governed by an exponential capital exhaustion curve for each sibling spawned in a swarm. Like a marble jetty shielding a calm lagoon from turbulent tides, this superlinear bonding requirement imposes an unsustainable polynomial-to-exponential cost on coordinated adversary swarms.
